variants.cockpit: Single-seat cockpit under a bubble canopy with a centre stick and the throttle on the left console. The PCA armament panel under the VTH head-up display and the VTB radar display in the middle of the main panel are the main interface.
variants.notes: Modes are the SNA modes (NAV, A/A, A/G; flight manual 11-1, 11-2, 21-5). Callouts follow the HOTAS tables (p.42-44); stick item 1 is the trigger safety indicator, not a control. Panel items follow the bullet order of chapter 1-2 (figure callouts read as 1..N in bullet order). The radio selection switch directions follow the DCS key names; the physical throw is not stated. Trim hat directions assumed forward = nose down.

variants.cockpit: Single-seat glass cockpit with three MFCDs, a HUD with the up-front control panel and an F-16-like HOTAS: eight controls on the stick (S1-S8) and six on the throttle (T1-T6).
variants.notes: HOTAS from the quick guide tables (p.73-77, pictures). The A/A columns are merged: INTC search (no lock), INTC with a locked target (HPT, SAM, DTT, STT summarised in one cell) and ACM (DGFT). The throttle table header repeats INTC / "w/o locked target" by mistake; its columns follow the stick table. Panels come from the pre-start check lists and the warning chapter (no figure callouts, clickables are encrypted), so positions are partly guessed; the AAP has only the CMBT and TRAIN presets named.
